decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm's core handcrafted seasonal range and a product line featured prominently in 2018 and 2019, it likely met aspiration levels well enough that a firm with some slack would retain it.

This pyramid sits very near the established business and was highlighted on the home page in both observed years, so management would likely see no performance shortfall large enough to trigger dropping it.

Although more distant from the firm's traditional capabilities, it was presented as a flagship line and supported over multiple models and years, suggesting sufficient promise for management to continue backing it rather than abandon it quickly.

Its own page in 2019 and the mention of a second edition indicate continuing investment and at least satisfactory reception, but as a niche accessory tied to the riskier electronic line it remains more exposed than the core craft products.

As a seasonal accessory within the more experimental electronic music-box family, it likely faces the greatest risk of falling below aspiration levels and being pruned so resources can be shifted to stronger core or development projects.

This Dresden-themed pyramid builds directly on the firm's established strengths and was home-page featured in both observed years, making it the kind of differentiated core-adjacent product a mature German craft firm would usually keep.
